blocker: Should formats/odi/manifest.py prioritize the task's alias-assignment requirement, or the current GATE3 manifest verifier requirement that MANIFEST be a parseable inline dict?
blocker_context: I verified both branches of the implementation. A package-alias MANIFEST satisfies the task text and AC1/AC2, but GATE3 fails because run_verifier.py uses ast.literal_eval on MANIFEST and cannot parse a Name reference. An inline-dict MANIFEST makes GATE3 and compliance_bouncer pass, but fails the reviewer/task ACs that require alias delegation. The two requirements are mutually exclusive without changing the verifier or the task spec.
